title: Tone of voice · Foundation
summary: Recognise the difference between restrained confidence and language that feels inflated, generic or over-written.
contentNotice: Demonstration learning content for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy, curriculum or language instruction and must be reviewed before operational use.

blocks.text: MOSCATELLI language should make precision feel effortless. It should not depend on superlatives, manufactured mystique or repeated claims of luxury to create stature.

items: Remove claims that cannot be demonstrated.
Prefer one precise noun or verb over stacked adjectives.
Keep institutional writing calm even when the subject is important.
Allow product, material and context to carry prestige.
